name: GoStore
description: Online general-merchandise retailer in Uruguay on WooCommerce. Sells technology, tools, home, kids, pet, cosmetics, clothing, sports and outdoor products. States shipping to all of Uruguay; same-day delivery depends on the buyer's area.
description_es: Comercio online de artículos generales en Uruguay sobre WooCommerce. Vende tecnología, herramientas, hogar, niños, mascotas, cosmética, indumentaria, deportes y aire libre. Indica envíos a todo Uruguay; la entrega el mismo día depende de la zona del comprador.

ships_to.notes: Homepage states shipping to all of Uruguay. Cost and interior times not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup center UES and GestionPost, and a location in Las Toscas, Canelones; the page notes there is no public store.
